about: Ledger of every story WWIT MMA News has posted. The hourly run reads this before posting, so the same story is never posted twice unless there is a real update. Newest stories first.

stories.title: Dana White says UFC is producing Fury vs. Joshua; Eddie Hearn calls White's side 'control freaks'
stories.event: Fury vs. Joshua (Dec 11, 2026, Cardiff)
facts: White at UFC 332 presser: UFC is promoting and producing the whole Fury-Joshua show
Hearn says Joshua's contract bars White/Zuffa unless Matchroom allows it; blamed White's 'arrogance', called them 'control freaks'
White says Hearn is trying to win a PR battle; White skipped London launch presser

stories.title: Dana White credits Wang Cong with Natalia Silva's wins; fans roast him
stories.event: UFC 332 (Oct 3, Salt Lake City)
facts: White credited Wang with wins over Namajunas, Andrade, Grasso; those were Silva's
White correctly cited Wang's 2015 kickboxing win over Shevchenko
Fans called it 'laughably sad'

stories.title: Rafael dos Anjos open to Conor McGregor fight after UFC 332, won't wait for it
stories.event: UFC 332 (Oct 3)
facts: Dos Anjos faces Hernandez at UFC 332 in his 50th pro fight
Says McGregor fight 'would be awesome' but won't wait like Chandler did
McGregor replied 'Thank you Rafael'; UFC 196 bout in 2016 fell through due to RDA injury

stories.title: Dana White agrees King Green deserves BMF title shot if he beats Ribovics at UFC 332
stories.event: UFC 332 (Oct 3)
facts: White: 'I absolutely agree' Green fits BMF title fight
Green, 40, on four-fight win streak; called BMF title a dream
Ribovics called Green 'Minnie Mouse' at presser

stories.title: Nicolle Caliari vs. Iasmin Lucindo added to UFC 333 (Abu Dhabi)
stories.event: UFC 333
facts: Strawweight bout added per MMA Junkie
Lucindo returns from 9-month mesterolone suspension; CSAD accepted contaminated supplement explanation
Caliari coming off sub win over Shauna Bannon in May

stories.title: Paddy Pimblett says he'd be furious if Arman Tsarukyan gets next lightweight title shot
stories.event: UFC lightweight title picture
facts: Pimblett credited Tsarukyan's KO of Mauricio Ruffy but said he looked 'very average' before the finish
Said Tsarukyan couldn't take Ruffy down while BSD did repeatedly; Pimblett has beaten BSD
Argued Tsarukyan hasn't beaten anyone ranked higher than Pimblett's opponents since UFC 300
Gaethje named Tsarukyan next; Dana White hasn't confirmed; Topuria rematch also possible

stories.title: Wang Cong says Natalia Silva won't sell UFC 332 fight; Silva: 'she can get cute by herself'
stories.event: UFC 332 (Oct 3, 2026, Delta Center, Salt Lake City)
facts: At the Oct 1 UFC 332 press conference, Wang criticized Silva for not helping promote the fight
Wang said she wrote Silva a note with a plan for the ceremonial weigh-in faceoff; Silva didn't look at it
Silva: if Wang wants to get cute she can do it herself; this is her dream and she's there to fight, not play
Related: wang-cong-no-need-to-beat-shevchenko, silva-dismisses-critics-wang-toughest-fight

stories.title: Deiveson Figueiredo shoves Payton Talbott at UFC 332 press conference faceoff
stories.event: UFC 332 (Oct 3, 2026, Delta Center, Salt Lake City) bantamweight co-main
facts: Figueiredo gave Talbott a shove during faceoffs at the Oct 1 UFC 332 press conference (MMA Junkie)
Figueiredo told MMA Fighting the card criticism is annoying and he's happy the UFC keeps him on main cards
Related: figueiredo-calls-for-van-title-shot, talbott-omalley-white-house-claim

stories.title: Joe Rogan says oblique kicks to the knee should be banned (JRE MMA Show #186)
stories.event: Oblique kick ban debate (related: sterling-vs-oblique-kick-ban)
facts: On JRE MMA Show #186 with Sean Sharaf, Rogan argued oblique/side kicks to the knee should be banned, comparing them to eye pokes (permanent damage, can't tap out)
Rogan cited Jon Jones vs. Thiago Santos and Rampage Jackson; Sharaf was more ambivalent, calling it realistic fighting
CSAC's Andy Foster raised a possible ban under the Unified Rules after UFC 331 (Sep 2026); Dana White said the UFC doesn't disagree

stories.title: Josh Hokit revives 'witchcraft' claims about Alex Pereira ahead of UFC 334
stories.event: UFC 334: Gane vs. Hokit, November 14, 2026, Madison Square Garden, New York
facts: On the Believe Me You podcast (clip circulated Oct 1), Hokit claimed Pereira's 'Chama' chant is shaman witchcraft and insulted Pereira
Similar to Prochazka's claims before UFC 295/303; Pereira's camp says he doesn't practice witchcraft; 'Chama' roughly means 'let's go'
Hokit (10-0) faces Ciryl Gane for the heavyweight title at UFC 334; wants Pereira next
Pereira's next fight to be revealed by Dana White on the UFC 332 Kick stream (Oct 3)

stories.title: Jared Gordon vs. Melquizael Costa added to UFC 334 at lightweight (Nov 14, MSG)
stories.event: UFC 334: Gane vs. Hokit, November 14, 2026, Madison Square Garden, New York
facts: Lightweight bout Jared Gordon vs. Melquizael Costa added to UFC 334; first reported by AG Fight, confirmed to Heavy by multiple sources
Costa (No. 12 featherweight) moves up to lightweight; his six-fight win streak ended in a main-event loss to Arnold Allen
Gordon (New York native) is on a two-fight losing streak, most recently a first-round guillotine loss to Jim Miller in 2026
UFC 334 is headlined by Ciryl Gane vs. Josh Hokit (interim HW title)

stories.title: Dan Hardy says Dana White's UFC time has passed, floats Ronda Rousey as successor
stories.event: UFC leadership (commentary)
facts: Dan Hardy (ex-UFC welterweight title challenger, now with PFL Europe) said White seems more focused on Zuffa Boxing and Power Slap and the UFC would benefit from new leadership
Hardy named Ronda Rousey, not Hunter Campbell, as a possible successor
Speculation only; Rousey has not officially expressed interest; White remains UFC CEO

stories.title: Natália Silva shrugs off UFC 332 critics, calls Wang Cong her toughest fight
stories.event: UFC 332: Silva vs. Wang, October 3, 2026, Delta Center, Salt Lake City
facts: Silva told MMA Junkie the criticism of UFC 332 doesn't matter to her; people have doubted her all her life
She says Wang Cong will be her toughest fight
Silva: 20-5-1, 8-0 UFC, 14-fight win streak incl. Alexa Grasso and Rose Namajunas
Wang: 10-1, 5-1 UFC; vacant flyweight title after Shevchenko vacated

stories.title: Wang Cong says she doesn't need to beat Valentina Shevchenko to be the real flyweight champion
stories.event: UFC 332: Silva vs. Wang, October 3, 2026, Delta Center, Salt Lake City
facts: Wang told MMA Junkie she doesn't need to beat Shevchenko to feel like the real flyweight champion
Wang faces No. 1 contender Natália Silva for the vacant women's flyweight title in the UFC 332 main event
Shevchenko vacated the title due to injury in September (ESPN)
Wang: former kickboxer, 10-1, four-fight win streak

posts.image: fighter photo (Natália Silva; no Wang Cong photo)

stories.title: Jon Anik questions whether Gable Steveson will even reach 10 UFC fights after 12-second KO loss
stories.event: UFC 331 aftermath (Sept 19, 2026, Crypto.com Arena, Los Angeles)
facts: Anik questioned whether Steveson will make it to 10 UFC fights (Bloody Elbow, Oct 1)
Sean Sharaf KO'd Steveson in 12 seconds on the UFC 331 main card, Sept 19, LA; Sharaf ~+1000 underdog, Steveson ~-2500
First pro MMA loss for Steveson; he vowed to come back stronger
Requested by the user

stories.title: Adama Diop becomes the first fighter from Senegal to sign with the UFC
stories.event: Dana White's Contender Series Season 10, Sept 30, 2026
facts: Diop beat Zaurbek Sabanov by TKO at 2:13 of R2 on DWCS Sept 30 and earned a UFC contract
First Senegalese fighter signed by the UFC
Heavyweight, 6-1, former Senegalese traditional wrestler, EFC heavyweight champion (won April 2026 at EFC 132)
No UFC debut date yet

posts.image: silhouette graphic (Commons photo was a different Adama Diop)

stories.title: Alexander Hernandez says federal agents questioned him after UFC 324 bout was scrapped over suspicious betting
facts: Hernandez vs. Michael Johnson at UFC 324 was canceled over suspicious betting (late money on Johnson)
Told Ariel Helwani that federal agents questioned him for about an hour, asked about messaging apps (Signal), then let him leave; says he had nothing to do with fight-fixing
Faces Rafael dos Anjos at UFC 332, Oct 3, Salt Lake City; lost to Rafa Garcia in April, snapping a 4-fight win streak

stories.title: Paddy Pimblett pitches a TUF coaching season opposite Ilia Topuria
stories.event: The Ultimate Fighter (proposed)
facts: Pimblett wants to coach TUF opposite Topuria to get in his head, citing McGregor vs. Aldo build-up
Feud dates to a 2022 hotel altercation at UFC London; Pimblett first floated TUF idea in 2023
Topuria lost to Justin Gaethje at UFC White House and says he's medically cleared to return this month
No fight or TUF season announced

stories.title: Raoni Barcelos discharged from hospital after losing consciousness vs. Raul Rosas Jr.; Dana White says he's doing well
stories.event: UFC Fight Night (UFC Vegas 121), late Sept 2026
facts: Barcelos (39) lost consciousness on the canvas in Round 5 vs. Raul Rosas Jr. after a takedown, stretchered out; medical stoppage loss
Hospitalized 3 days, then discharged; thanked fans on social media
Dana White: he's up walking and talking; six doctors and three ambulances were on site; not thinking about his fighting future

stories.title: Aljamain Sterling opposes CSAC's Andy Foster's proposal to ban oblique kicks
stories.event: Unified Rules debate after UFC 331
facts: Andy Foster (CSAC) proposed banning oblique kicks to the knee under the Unified Rules after UFC 331
Sterling, on Ariel Helwani's show: enforce existing rules first; CTE risk from head strikes is the bigger issue
Thiago Santos also opposes a ban; Dana White said the UFC doesn't disagree with Foster's concerns
Sterling faces Kevin Vallejos at UFC Qatar, Nov 21

stories.title: Colby Covington says he'll wrestle Sean Strickland at any weight at RAF Las Vegas (Oct 23), disputing report he turned the match down
stories.event: RAF (Real American Freestyle) Las Vegas, Oct 23, 2026
facts: MMAmania (Sept 29) reported RAF offered Covington vs. UFC middleweight champ Strickland for Oct 23 in Las Vegas; talks broke down over weight (Strickland 200 lbs, Covington 190)
Covington on X: 'Fake news. I'll wrestle Strickland at any weight he wants October 23rd' in Las Vegas
Covington is 5-0 in RAF, defends RAF Cruiserweight Crossover title vs. Khamzat Chimaev, Nov 14, Etihad Arena, Abu Dhabi
Oct 1: Bloody Elbow framed it as Covington calling to face Strickland before wrestling Chimaev

stories.title: Deiveson Figueiredo wants to return to flyweight and challenge champion Joshua Van
stories.event: UFC 332
facts: At UFC 332 media day (Sept 30), Figueiredo said he's been asking the UFC to let him drop back to 125 lbs and can make the weight easily
Says he would knock out flyweight champion Joshua Van
Faces Payton Talbott in UFC 332 co-main event, Oct 3, Salt Lake City (bantamweight)
Figueiredo is 38, a two-time former UFC flyweight champ, on a two-fight skid; Manel Kape seen as top 125 contender

stories.title: Alex Pereira teases a 'big challenge' for his UFC return
stories.event: UFC 332 (announcement)
facts: Pereira posted on Instagram: good news is coming, 'a big challenge'
No opponent or date officially announced; outlets speculate Sergei Pavlovich (No. 2 HW)
Pereira is No. 3 at heavyweight; last fought June 2026, TKO loss to Ciryl Gane for interim HW title at UFC Freedom 250
Gane defends interim title vs. Josh Hokit at UFC 334 on Nov. 14
Oct 1: Dana White confirmed he'll announce Pereira's next fight during the UFC 332 Kick stream (Sat., Oct. 3), per Bloody Elbow

stories.title: Payton Talbott says a Sean O'Malley fight was in the works for UFC Freedom 250 (White House) before falling through; faces Figueiredo at UFC 332
stories.event: UFC 332: Silva vs. Wang, October 3, 2026, Delta Center, Salt Lake City
facts: Talbott said on his YouTube channel he was supposed to fight O'Malley at UFC Freedom 250 in June
Several planned opponents fell through, citing injuries; Talbott questioned whether it was the UFC or fighters being scared
Broken feet also kept Talbott sidelined
Talbott (5-1 UFC) faces Deiveson Figueiredo in the UFC 332 co-main event; last fought Dec 2025, beating Henry Cejudo at UFC 323

posts.image: fighter photo (Sean O'Malley; no usable Talbott photo)

stories.title: UFC Fight Night returns to Sydney, Feb. 6 (U.S.) / Feb. 7 local, 2027, at Afterpay Arena
stories.event: UFC Fight Night Sydney, February 6/7, 2027, Afterpay Arena (formerly Qudos Bank Arena), Sydney
facts: Officially announced by the UFC
First Sydney Fight Night since 2017; fourth straight year of a UFC event in New South Wales
No fights announced yet; Volkanovski headlining UFC 333 next month
Presale registration open at UFC.com/Sydney

stories.title: Aljamain Sterling vs. Kevin Vallejos co-headlines UFC Qatar (Nov 21); Sterling says he had one hour to accept, rejected Aaron Pico
stories.event: UFC Fight Night Qatar, November 21, 2026, Ali Bin Hamad Al Attiyah Arena, Al Rayyan
facts: Sterling vs. Vallejos is the featherweight co-main event at UFC Qatar on November 21
Sterling says the UFC gave him one hour to accept the fight
Sterling turned down Aaron Pico at UFC 333, saying the fight did nothing for his title push
Vallejos is undefeated

stories.title: Anthony Romero replaces injured Bernardo Sopaj vs. Marcus McGhee at UFC 332 (Oct 3)
stories.event: UFC 332: Silva vs. Wang, October 3, 2026, Delta Center, Salt Lake City
facts: Bernardo Sopaj withdrew from his bout with Marcus McGhee with an injury, three days before the event
Newcomer Anthony Romero (7-2, UNF bantamweight champion, Black House MMA, 26) steps in
Bout moved from bantamweight to featherweight
McGhee is No. 15-ranked at bantamweight, 11-2 overall

stories.title: Jiri Prochazka vs. Navajo Stirling headlines UFC Qatar (Nov 21)
stories.event: UFC Fight Night Qatar, November 21, 2026
facts: Light heavyweight main event, UFC Fight Night in Qatar on November 21, 2026
Stirling undefeated, coming off a stoppage of Jan Blachowicz in August
Prochazka coming off a knockout loss to Carlos Ulberg
